# DLY AI

> DLY AI is a forward-deployed AI engineering team. Senior engineers embed with client teams to take complex AI from idea to production.

## What DLY AI does

- Designs, builds and deploys production AI systems.
- Embeds senior AI engineers inside client teams and existing technology stacks.
- Works from discovery through deployment, measurement and iteration.
- Handles AI product, enterprise-system and semiconductor-grade engineering problems.

## Who DLY AI works with

DLY AI works with organisations in the UK and US, including consumer products, fintech, healthcare, industrial companies, enterprise SaaS, space systems and semiconductor engineering.

## Evidence

- 30+ production systems shipped.
- 93% repeat engagement.
- 20+ domains served.
- Average delivery cycle: 1.8 months.

## Example work

- Enterprise AI research workspace connecting sources, analysis and reporting.
- AI legal intake, lawyer ranking and appointment booking.
- eSIM recommendation, automated activation and live usage management.
- Agent-executable engineering workflows for drawing recognition, validation and process routing.
